reason: Candidate A more directly addresses how microstructural inhomogeneities in non-equiatomic high-entropy alloy nanofilms or ribbons would alter the magnetocaloric properties under low fields, and proposes a clear annealing-based experimental test. This mechanism is physically consistent with known effects of strain/compositional gradients in high-entropy alloys and provides a non-trivial approach to mitigating hysteresis and restoring magnetocaloric performance in thin-film regimes.
